confirmDialog.title: Confirm allocation
confirmDialog.body: This capitalises {total} CHF onto the inventory value of the received items and posts one balanced journal entry. It is undone by a reversal, never by rewriting.

reverseDialog.title: Reverse allocation
reverseDialog.body: This posts a reversing journal entry and removes the capitalised cost from the inventory value of the items. The original entry stays on the ledger.

errors.already_allocated: One of these receipt lines is already allocated under another voucher.
errors.nothing_to_allocate: No recognised receipt lines to allocate against.
errors.invalid_transition: The voucher is not in a state that allows this action.
errors.invalid_reference: A referenced receipt line or account was not found.
errors.invalid_amount: The amount must be a positive figure.
errors.allocation_residual: The allocation did not distribute the full total.

LandedCosts.title: Landed costs
LandedCosts.body:
Freight, duty and handling that belong to a posted goods receipt are collected here on a landed-cost voucher.

The preview shows how the costs spread across the received lines before anything is written. On confirmation the amounts flow into the inventory value of the items and one balanced entry is posted.

A confirmation is undone by a reversal, never by rewriting.
